headline: Peru and China Incorporate Country Brand Protection in Free Trade Deal
summary: Peru and China included a specific provision on country brand protection within the optimization protocol of their bilateral Free Trade Agreement, which entered into force on November 1, 2026.
why: Bilateral trade agreements between emerging economies and major trading partners affect export frameworks and intellectual property rights.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Optimized trade treaties affect bilateral commercial exchange and legal protections for exporters.
